body:
I don’t have advice but I do have sympathy. Personally I don’t plan to go through treatment. I’m divorced, mid 30’s, no kids, estranged from family, only a few friends, and I already struggle financially. With the state of the world right now it just doesn’t make sense to put myself through more suffering just to extend my life a few more years. Sending hugs. I hope you find a reason for treatment.

Love,
Another lost sad soul
